title: Loop Assembly Using Labcyte Echo 550
author: Susana Sauret-Gueto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8zvhx66

steps.title: Prepare LDV Source Plate
steps.instruction: Create a 384-LDV source plate containing the required plasmids (L0 parts for L1 Loops; L1 plasmids for L2 Loops), excluding APs.

substeps.instruction: Use Echo calibration 384LDV_AQ_B2.
Fill wells with 10 µl of each plasmid (working range 3-12 µl; dead volume 3 µl).
Ensure source plasmid final concentration is 15 nM (approximate concentration in ng/µl = plasmid length in bp / 110).
Seal and store at -20°C; maintain a CSV file tracking source wells and sample names.

steps.title: Prepare PP Source Plate
steps.instruction: Create a 384-PP source plate containing APs, Master Mix (MM), and water.

substeps.instruction: For L1 Loops: include pCk APs and L1-MM-BsaI.
For L2 Loops: include pCs APs and L2-MM-SapI.
Use Echo calibration 384PP_AQ_BP2.
Fill wells with 30-50 µl of plasmid (working range 15-65 µl; dead volume 15 µl).
Set APs (pCks, pCs) to 7.5 nM and Loop plasmids with spacers to 15 nM.
Allocate two wells for water and MM (note: MM dead volume is higher, approx 18 µl).
Seal and store at -20°C; maintain a CSV file tracking source wells and sample names.

steps.title: Plan Reactions and Generate CSV
steps.instruction: Organize the required Loop reactions and generate the transfer file for the Labcyte Cherry Pick software.

substeps.instruction: Create a CSV file listing all Loops to be performed, separating Loop1 from Loop2.
Generate a Cherry Pick CSV including: Source Plate Name, Source Well, Destination Well, Sample Name, Transfer Volume, Source Plate Type, Destination Plate Name, and Destination Plate Type.
Simulate the run on the Echo to verify the CSV information is correct.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix (MM)
steps.instruction: Prepare the MM in an Eppendorf tube first to ensure components are well mixed before transferring to the PP source plate.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volume based on total plate reactions plus the PP plate dead volume.
Mix by pipetting in the tube, then transfer to the PP-well.

steps.title: Execute Echo Assembly
steps.instruction: Perform the acoustic liquid transfer to assemble the Loops in skirted 384-PCR plates.

substeps.instruction: Defrost, spin down, and keep LDV and PP source plates at room temperature (RT).
Prepare, spin, and keep MM at RT.
Set final reaction volume to 500 nl.
For L2 Loops: Transfer 250 nl of MM and 250 nl of plasmids (50 nl each of 5 plasmids: pCsA, L1_001-Ck, L1_002-Ck, L1_004-Ck, L1_005-Ck).
For L1 Loops: Adjust MM volume based on the number of plasmids (4-7); assume 6 plasmids and use water for empty positions to maintain 500 nl total.
Run the assembly and re-run any failed dispensations.
Seal the 384-PCR plate with PCR foil and spin down.

steps.title: Thermocycler Programming
steps.instruction: Run the assembled plates through the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Assembly: 26 cycles of 37 °C for 3 minutes and 16 °C for 4 minutes.
Termination and enzyme denaturation: 50 °C for 5 minutes and 80 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transformation and Selection
steps.instruction: Transform the assembly products into highly competent cells (10^8, e.g., homemade Top10 HS).

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µl of cells to each well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Heat shock at 42 °C for 40 seconds in a thermocycler.
Incubate on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 15 µl of LB to each well.
Seal with a breath-easy membrane and incubate at 37 °C on a shaker for 1 hour.
Plate ~18 µl of the reaction onto LB agar plates containing X-gal (40 ng/mL) and either Kanamycin (50 µg/mL for L1) or Spectinomycin (100 µg/mL for L2).
Incubate plates for 15 minutes, then overnight at 37 °C.
Identify white colonies as containing an insert.
